findings.problem: The plan says the second-round reply will hold topics, key ideas, and caveats as item/support objects. The current second round—and the card spec—serve only topics and key ideas; its schema has no caveats. As written, implementation would either incorrectly expand the second round beyond the specified behavior or leave the plan incomplete.
findings.suggestion: State that the earlier card reply changes topics, key ideas, and caveats, while the second-round reply changes only topics and key ideas; tailor its schema and tests to those two fields.

findings.problem: The new maximum length for a note point is never specified. “Longer” and comparison to quote handling do not establish an implementable boundary for the required acceptance/refusal tests.
findings.suggestion: Name the exact new point limit (and whether it is intended to match the existing 600-character quote ceiling), then use that value in the outcome, tests, and prompt-size assessment.

summary: The plan has two material ambiguities in its format-change increments: it overstates the fields in the second round, and it omits the new note-point limit.
